aesthetic settings.appearance: change app theme. custom themes may need app refresh/save to appear
aesthetic settings.scaling factor: scaling factor, especially for window managers

hardware settings.graphics manufacturer: graphics manufacturer of the system (ie Intel, AMD, NVIDIA)
hardware settings.target card name: name of the target training card

software information.OS full: full name of the operating system
software information.OS kernel: kernel version of the operating system

resource settings.cloud provider name: name of the cloud provider (if applicable)
resource settings.local hostname: hostname of the local machine (if applicable)
resource settings.trainer browser: browser to use for training (defaults to default browser) (if applicable)

security settings.local key file path: path to the local key file (if applicable)
security settings.project mod: allow project file modifications without asking
security settings.all files: allow all file modifications without asking

qol settings.reels provider: provider of the reels widget in URL format (if applicable)
qol settings.site provider: provider of the site widget in URL format (if applicable)
qol settings.resources: resources widget: true (on), false (off), or "ask" (prompt each visit)
qol settings.database provider: name of the database provider in URL format (if applicable)
